Relaxing chilled vibes
Apr 2026 • Couples
Really good tasty food. So much choice and freshly made to serve. 
I ordered the Saigon salad bowl and it was plentiful. A lot of flavour to it also. Felt very healthy, nutritious and filling. 
It has decent pricing for what you get.
The atmosphere in the restaurant is very relaxed and calm. 
We sat by the little koi carp pond, that had a little waterfall into it. This added to the chilled vibes. 
We really enjoyed the food and the laid back atmosphere. 
100% recommend if you want to get out of the heat in Nha Trang
